notes: Adapted from the fork's single shared warlock preset (ui/warlock/apls/rotation.apl.json). Dropped the shared preset's prepull Demonic Sacrifice (18788): the talent tree names that id as the tier 2 Demonology talent's own spell, but the build's spellconst has no entry for 18788 at all, so this build cannot cast it under that id -- a concern for the engine lane to resolve (either a different cast id for the sacrifice effect or the talent is not yet implemented client-side). Corruption and Life Tap were kept from the shared preset. Fixed the same stale Shadow Bolt rank the preset carried (25307 cast at rank 9 where the build's current top rank is 10). Immolate and the Bane of Agony curse maintenance from the shared preset were dropped -- Demonology's own capstone is meant to be Decimation (440870), a talent that is supposed to drop Soul Fire's 60 second cooldown to near nothing after a Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain crit. Fix round 1: Decimation has no implementation anywhere in sim/warlock (it exists only in the talent-tree metadata table), and sim/warlock/soul_fire.go hardcodes Soul Fire's cooldown as a flat, unconditional 60 seconds with nothing that shortens it on a crit -- so today Soul Fire is fully castable (rank 2, 17924, confirmed SpellFlagAPL) but only ever comes off cooldown once a minute, not near-continuously. Soul Fire is still placed ahead of the Shadow Bolt filler so it fires the instant it is off cooldown either way, but the priority is future-proofed for when Decimation lands rather than a description of today's cadence; Shadow Bolt fills the rest. Every rank named here is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/.

priorityList.notes: Potion at the top of the fight if mana is already below 75 percent.
Life Tap to keep casting once mana runs low.
Corruption is cheap sustained damage that does not compete with Shadow Bolt casts.

Soul Fire on cooldown. Future-proofed for Decimation (440870), which is meant to drop this 60 second cooldown to near nothing after a Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain crit -- not yet implemented in this engine build (sim/warlock/soul_fire.go has a flat, unshortened cooldown), so today this simply casts once a minute.
Shadow Bolt is the default filler and what feeds Decimation's proc.
